title: Apple SPI keyboard and trackpad on the older MacBooks

clauses.text: the Apple SPI keyboard works and its Function keys mode choice applies

steps.do: On the MacBook, type in a text field, then open Settings, Keyboard and read the driver line.
steps.expect: The keys are typed and the page names the Apple SPI driver. Trackpad tap and Trackpad scroll are offered.

clauses.text: the trackpad moves the pointer and clicks as the Feature says

steps.do: Move one finger across the trackpad, then tap once with one finger, tap once with two fingers, and slide two fingers up and down.
steps.expect: The pointer moves with acceleration, one tap is a left click, a two-finger tap is a right click, and two fingers scroll.

steps.do: Press the physical click, then press the physical click with two fingers down, then with a finger in the bottom right corner.
steps.expect: A plain press is a left click; two fingers or the bottom right corner give a right click.
